name: color
meaning: COLOR; bytes 0..2 are scaled for the fades

name: colorBytes
meaning: the bytes of color, low byte first; CreditsManager_Render scales bytes 0..2 for the fades

name: latchedScreenX
meaning: projected x (512 wide) frozen while rot.x rises

name: prevRotX
meaning: rot.x of the last render; a rising rot.x (animated by a cinematic) latches the screen position

name: timeAppearMs
meaning: TIME_APP (fade-in length; also, wrongly, the fade-out divisor)

name: state
meaning: CreditsState 0 wait, 1 fade in, 2 shown, 3 fade out

name: active
meaning: set by msg 0x12, cleared by msg 0x13 / end of fade out
